title.narrative: Integrated prevention and response to violence against women and girls in North wollo, Amhara region Ethiopia

description.narrative: In the North Wollo zone of the Amhara region, different forms of GBV/VAWG such as early marriage (e.g., the prevalence of girls' early marriage was 81.8% (Pathfinder- 2023), and 45% of girls in the Amhara region are married before 14), abduction, and FGM (e.g., with the prevalence of 62% in the region) were the most reported GBV cases. Likewise, physical, or sexual violence or both by an intimate partner is 64.7% among ever-married women (Mesfin A. 2017). These are reinforced by cultural, economic, and religious justifications. Consequently, the various forms of violence resulted in complications attributed to distress and disruption in individuals, families, and communities. Thus, with the financial support of UN trust Fund Christain aid with ELIDA has been implementing this project in North Wollo with the objective to prevent violence against women (2023 -2026). The project will be embedded with EVAW/G program principles across its different phases. Hence, ELiDA and CA will employ human rights based approach which can be demonstrated in terms of upholding the rights of the people to access at least the available services, promoting the local government authorities to discharge their obligations as duty bearers to prevent and respond to violence against women and girls, focus on the human elements of the women and girls to eliminate discriminatory tendencies while addressing their need, and supporting the people with the belief that they are right holders of the services and entitled to access them. To this end, ELiDA and CA will review the relevant human rights instruments, and conduct assessments to identify where the practices and responses may conflict with the rights of women and girls.
